description: Return a complete, structured directory of every FreightFA capability and the exact tool(s) that power each one: freight invoice auditing (including uploaded PDF/image invoices in chat), multi-mode rate benchmarking (truckload, LTL, intermodal, rail, barge), daily market briefs and outlooks, FMCSA carrier vetting, RFP creation, lane rate alerts, import duty estimation, multi-leg network costing, margin calculation, pushback email drafting, freight news, glossary, and Freight Flow AI. Call this whenever the user asks what FreightFA can do, connects FreightFA for the first time, or wants to explore all available tools. Takes no inputs and does not count toward the estimate allowance.
name: list_capabilities
title: List all FreightFA capabilities and tools
